title: 第27章 七十年功力，突破六品！
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
之后的一日，倒是平静无比。

    官银案涉及到的大人物都收敛线索，要查也不是能一下能查出来的。

    子时。

    天牢深处，寂静无声。

    陈然盘膝坐在丁字号狱卒房的硬木床上。

    识海之中，镇狱天书翻开崭新的一页，金芒如水波般流转。

    【子时已到，今日坐镇天牢，奖励一年功力。】

    【累计功力：七十年。】

    陈然体内发出一声沉闷的轰鸣。

    七十年的精纯内力，犹如决堤的江河，在四肢百骸中疯狂奔涌。

    原本已经凝练到极致的七品气血，在这股庞大力量的挤压下，开始发生质变。

    一丝丝液态的能量在丹田处成型。

    内息。

    武道六品，内息境。

    跨过这道门槛，武者的力量将不再单纯依赖肉体气血，而是能以内息外放，伤人于十步之外。

    就在内息成型的刹那。

    陈然体内运转的《红莲业火经》被自动激发。

    这门魔教顶级功法本就霸道异常，此刻随着六品内息的外溢，竟然与天牢地底淤积百年的阴寒煞气产生了强烈的共鸣。

    而这般异象，陈然还并不知情。

    呼——

    牢房通道内，肉眼可见的灰色煞气被疯狂扯动。

    在丁字号上空形成了一个微型的气旋。

    这股原本只属于六品武者的突破威压，在煞气气旋的加持下，呈几何倍数暴涨，几乎达到了令人战栗的地步。

    这股威压扫过。

    根本不是进阶六品能发出的动静！

    丁字号和丙字号牢房里，那些原本还在睡梦中的囚犯，直接被这气息给吓醒了。

    ……

    天牢中层，校尉值房。

    李长风正披着衣服，坐在灯下翻看卷宗。

    突然，他握笔的手猛地一顿。

    狼毫笔上的墨汁滴落在纸上，晕染开一大片黑斑。

    李长风霍然起身，目光死死盯向天牢底层的方向。

    那股气息带着狂暴的魔道真意，仿佛要将整个天牢掀翻。

    “这股威压……”

    李长风额头上渗出一层冷汗。

    他一把抓起墙上的佩刀，大步冲出房间。

    “来人！集合！去底层！”
content_en:
The day after that was extremely peaceful.

    The big names involved in the official bank case have all gathered together clues, and it is not possible to find out at once.

    Zishi.

    Deep in the prison, there was silence.

    Chen Ran sat cross-legged on the hardwood bed in the T-shaped jailer's room.

    In the sea of ​​consciousness, the Heavenly Book of Prison Suppression opened a new page, and the golden light flowed like water waves.

    [The time has come, I will sit in the Tianlao today and be rewarded with one year of skill. 】

    [Cumulative skill: seventy years. 】

    Chen Ran let out a dull roar inside his body.

    Seventy years of pure internal energy is like a river bursting its banks, rushing wildly through the limbs and bones.

    The seventh-grade qi and blood, which had been condensed to the extreme, began to undergo qualitative changes under the squeeze of this huge force.

    A trace of liquid energy formed in the Dantian.

    Inner breath.

    Sixth level of martial arts, inner breath realm.

    After crossing this threshold, the warrior's power will no longer rely solely on the body's energy and blood, but will be able to release internal energy and injure people ten steps away.

    At the moment when the inner breath takes shape.

    The "Red Lotus Karma Fire Sutra" running in Chen Ran's body was automatically activated.

    This demon sect's top skill was already extremely overbearing, but at this moment, as the sixth-grade inner energy overflowed, it actually resonated strongly with the cold evil energy that had accumulated for hundreds of years in the Tianlao underground.

    Chen Ran was not aware of this strange phenomenon.

    Huh——

    In the cell passage, the gray evil energy visible to the naked eye was being pulled wildly.

    A miniature cyclone formed over the T.

    This breakthrough coercion that originally only belonged to sixth-grade warriors, with the blessing of the evil cyclone, increased exponentially, almost reaching a terrifying level.

    This coercion swept across.

    It’s not a sound that an advanced sixth-grade person can make!

    In the cells of size T and size C, the prisoners who were still sleeping were directly awakened by this breath.

    …

    On the middle floor of the prison, the captain is on duty.

    Li Changfeng was wearing clothes and sitting under the lamp reading files.

    Suddenly, his hand holding the pen suddenly stopped.

    The ink on the Langhao pen dripped onto the paper, smearing out a large black spot.

    Li Changfeng suddenly stood up and stared in the direction of the bottom floor of the prison.

    That breath carried the violent demonic true meaning, as if it was going to overturn the entire prison.

    "This pressure..."

    A layer of cold sweat broke out on Li Changfeng's forehead.

    He grabbed the saber on the wall and strode out of the room.

    "Come on! Assemble! Go to the bottom floor!"
title_en: Chapter 27 Seventy years of skill, breaking through to the sixth level!
